verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that Cua Driver lets an agent drive native apps on macOS, Windows and Linux through MCP or a CLI. Spaces can connect Mac, Windows or Linux computers, Lume provides macOS and Linux VMs, and the docs show an agent building a Windows app. Older community requests for Windows support predate these claims and do not concretely contradict them. Missing for 10: detailed per-target support documentation (feature differences, limitations per OS), mobile targets, and independent hands-on corroboration of Windows/Linux operation.
